work.summary: Bounded FINAL.20 field hotfix: show sold-out rows in the compact sales-journal review only when present, and carry the trusted same-visit machine context into the immediately continued input/recovery review so the operator is not asked to create another durable vendor→machine mapping for the same visit.
implemented: Added a compact sold-out card after 商品別売上 when candidatePayload.soldOuts is non-empty; empty soldOuts remains visually silent.
The sold-out card shows product code, matched product name, temperature, column and sold-out elapsed hours when available.
Added a small compact-review enhancement module loaded by ocr-config so the existing compact core and analytics engine remain unchanged.
Explicit `次の帳票を撮影` stores only a short-lived continuation UI context for the immediately following review.
The follow-up review shows `この訪問の自販機を継続 · 再紐づけ不要` and removes the redundant durable-link button only when the paper candidate does not conflict with the continued machine.
At draft save, the enhancement re-reads the exact Analytics visit returned by the existing ensureVisit callback and applies that visit's trusted machineId to the report review.

No durable machineLinks entry is created for the follow-up maker/vendor automatically; its normal bridge state remains management_match until the user explicitly creates such a mapping outside visit continuity.

If the follow-up paper has a concrete candidate for a different machine, the review shows a conflict, disables approval, and exact save-time reconciliation also throws rather than silently continuing.
No report auto-confirm, durable machine auto-link, inventory semantics, numeric forecasting, Analytics engine, DB or schema changes were introduced.
